description.value: You learn how to read the barriers between the planes, making it easier for you to draw forth more powerful creatures. When you expend a spell slot to cast a conjuration or necromancy spell that summons creatures, the spell counts as a number of spell levels lower for you for the purposes of which level of spell slot it requires. This reduction is equal to half your proficiency (rounded down). Further, it determines when you can learn these spells and also affects spells cast at a higher level. This feature cannot reduce the level of a spell below 1st.
